qs.s: Le charcutier a coupé le ___ sec en fines tranches pour l'apéritif.
qs.en: The butcher cut the dry sausage into thin slices for the aperitif.

qs.s: Pour le pique-nique, elle a emporté du pain, du fromage et un ___ entier.
qs.en: For the picnic, she brought bread, cheese and a whole sausage.

qs.en: The sausage had been hanging from the smokehouse ceiling for weeks.

qs.en: She bought a whole sausage at the market this morning.

qs.en: The architect built a scale model of the new building for the presentation to the clients.

qs.en: He made a cardboard model for his school project.

qs.s: Le client a laissé un généreux ___ au serveur.
qs.en: The customer left a generous tip for the waiter.

qs.s: N'oublie pas de laisser un ___ au chauffeur de taxi.
qs.en: Don't forget to leave a tip for the taxi driver.

qs.s: Elle a donné ___ pourboire au livreur.
qs.en: She gave a tip to the delivery person.

qs.s: En France, ___ pourboire n'est pas obligatoire, mais il est très apprécié.
qs.en: In France, the tip is not mandatory, but it is greatly appreciated.
